data.name: Question
data.value: DipsyPaint closed unexpectedly. Do you want to restore the unsaved changes to {0}, last recovered at {1}?
data.comment: {0} is the document's file name, or "Untitled"; {1} is the local date and time of the recovery snapshot.

data.name: CouldNotRestore
data.value: The unsaved changes to {0} could not be restored.
data.comment: {0} is the document's file name, or "Untitled". A reason may follow on the next line.

data.name: OverMemoryBudget
data.value: There isn't enough memory to restore it.
